db_instance_id.description: (Required) The ID of the existing PolarDBX instance. This module does NOT create instances - only manages backup policy for existing ones.

i18n.zh-Hans: （必填）现有PolarDB-X实例的ID。本模块不创建实例，仅管理现有实例的备份策略。
i18n.en-US: (Required) The ID of the existing PolarDB-X instance. This module does NOT create instances—only manages backup policies for existing ones.

backup_period.description: The backup cycle. You can select multiple days in a week. Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Multiple values are separated by commas.

i18n.zh-Hans: 备份周期。您可以选择一周中的多个日期。有效值：周一、周二、周三、周四、周五、周六、周日。多个值之间用逗号分隔。
i18n.en-US: The backup cycle. You can select multiple days of the week. Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Multiple values are separated by commas.

backup_set_retention.description: The retention period of the backup set. Valid values: 7 to 730 days.

i18n.zh-Hans: 备份集的保留期限，有效值：7至730天。
i18n.en-US: The retention period of the backup set. Valid values: 7 to 730 days.

backup_plan_begin.description: The start time of the backup. The time format is HH:mmZ, for example, 03:00Z.

i18n.zh-Hans: 备份的开始时间。时间格式为HH:mmZ，例如03:00Z。
i18n.en-US: The start time of the backup. The time format is HH:mmZ, for example, 03:00Z.

remove_log_retention.description: The retention period of transaction logs. Valid values: 7 to 730 days.

i18n.zh-Hans: 交易日志的保留期限，有效值为7至730天。
i18n.en-US: The retention period for transaction logs. Valid values: 7 to 730 days.

local_log_retention_number.description: The number of transaction logs retained locally. Valid values: 6 to 100.

i18n.zh-Hans: 本地保留的事务日志数量。有效值：6 到 100。
i18n.en-US: The number of transaction logs retained locally. Valid values: 6 to 100.

force_clean_on_high_space_usage.description: Specifies whether to forcibly delete backups when the storage space usage is high. Valid values: 0 (no), 1 (yes).

i18n.zh-Hans: 指定在存储空间使用率较高时是否强制删除备份。取值：0（否）、1（是）。
i18n.en-US: Specifies whether to forcibly delete backups when storage space usage is high. Valid values: 0 (no) and 1 (yes).

local_log_retention.description: The retention period of transaction logs that are retained locally. Unit: days.

i18n.zh-Hans: 本地保留的交易日志的保留期限，单位：天。
i18n.en-US: The retention period, in days, for transaction logs retained locally.

log_local_retention_space.description: The maximum space occupied by transaction logs that are retained locally. Unit: %. Valid values: 0 to 100.

i18n.zh-Hans: 本地保留的事务日志所占用的最大空间，单位为百分比（%）。有效值：0 到 100。
i18n.en-US: The maximum percentage of local disk space that can be occupied by retained transaction logs. Valid values: 0 to 100.

i18n.zh-Hans: 备份方法。默认值：P（物理备份）。
备份类型。默认值：0（完全备份）。
